title: Memos & Translation Of Letter From Shanghai No. 1 Special District Court

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. R. CISTRY
S. B. D. 2888
13. 11. 31.

Sir
I have to ack. receipt of your
letter № 1597 of November 7 and to
inform you that the warrant issued
against Jen Shi-shan (      ) was
returned to the Court for cancellation
together with all those issued prior
to Janr 1931.
Yours
McShine
President

此致

page_data.en:
Form 226
A.S. 600-5-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. RECEIVED D. 2888 Date 13 11 31）

Translation of Letter from Shanghai No. 1 Special District Court.

No. 1597    November ", 1931.

Commissioner of Police,
S. M. P.
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have received a letter No. 1572 from the
Kiangsu Provincial Government quoting an Instructional
Order No. 3588 from the Ministry of Administration and
a letter No. 8149 from the Disciplinary Board of the
National Government regarding the withdrawal of a
circular order of arrest against Yen Hi-shan (閻錫山).
I have to inform you that this circular order above
referred to is cancelled forthwith. Will you be good
enough to have this information circulated among all
districts concerned.

Yang Shao Hsu,
President.
page_data.zh:
表格 226
A.S. 600-5-31

上海公共租界工部局警务处
总监办公室

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与特别股 收讫 D. 2888 日期 1931年11月13日）

上海第一特区法院来函译文。

第1597号    1931年11月[日期残缺]日。

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务处总监
上海。

先生：

本部收到江苏省政府第1572号来函，援引行政院第3588号训令及国民政府惩戒委员会第8149号来函，关于撤销对阎锡山（Yen Hi-shan）的通缉令一事。特此通知，上述通缉令即刻撤销。请阁下惠予将此信息通报各有关辖区。

杨绍煦（Yang Shao Hsu），
院长。
